items.label: Daily Drawdown Limit
items.detail: Of previous day's closing balance. Resets daily at 17:00 NY Time. Static — does not trail.

items.label: Max Overall Drawdown
items.detail: Of initial balance. Static for account lifetime. Breach = immediate closure.

items.label: Profit Target P1
items.detail: Phase 1 target. Example: 8% for $50K account (may vary by size).

items.label: Min Profitable Days
items.detail: Minimum 2 profitable days (≥ 0.5% profit each) required per phase.

items.label: Notional Volume Limit
items.detail: Limit varies by account size. Breach = Soft Breach (strike).

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: Trading permitted at all times. Unbalanced exploitation of high-impact news events not permitted.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Triggered by daily or max drawdown violation. No recovery.

items.label: Soft Breach – Challenge
items.detail: Must return to positive balance before reset is permitted. 5 soft breaches during challenge = account closure. All breaches cleared upon reaching funded status.

items.label: Soft Breach – Funded
items.detail: Each breach reduces next payout by 10%. 5 soft breaches during funded = account closure.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starting split. On-demand after completing 2 minimum profitable days.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: After initial on-demand, payouts available weekly.

items.label: Fee Refund
items.detail: Challenge fee refunded on the 30th funded day if account is in profit.
